The water surface is clearly visible from above, and the top ellipse is about 6 rows including the rims, so this reads as a correct 3/4 barrel like the green guide barrel. The wood ramp has only about 3 browns (L117, 101, 70), the water has 3 blues plus a white highlight, and the hoops are flat grey. 89% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, and the thick black vertical side edges give the sticker look. The references use tinted dark-material outlines. The barrel is clean and readable but thinner and flatter than the Beodeul pieces, and its outline is not tinted.
